name: Get annotation by ID
description: Get annotation by ID Retrieves a single annotation by ID. GET /client/v4/radar/annotations/{id}
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/annotations/{id}
Retrieves a single annotation by ID.
Required: id (path) — Annotation ID.
Optional: format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.

name: Get latest annotations
description: Get latest annotations Retrieves the latest annotations. GET /client/v4/radar/annotations
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/annotations
Retrieves the latest annotations.
Optional: limit (query) — Limits the number of objects returned in the response.; offset (query) — Skips the specified number of objects before fetching the results.; dateRange (query) — Filters results by a relative date range ending at the current time. Use `<n>d` for days (up to `364d`) or `<n>w` for weeks (up to `52w`), e.g. `7d`. Append `control` to request the equivalent previous period for comparison: the comparison window is shifted back by the current window's length rounded up to a whole number of weeks, so it keeps the same weekday alignment and does not overlap the current window (e.g. `3dcontrol` covers days -10 to -7, `7dcontrol` covers days -14 to -7, `28dcontrol` covers days -56 to -28, and `10dcontrol` covers days -24 to -14). Mutually exclusive with `dateStart`/`dateEnd`.; dateStart (query) — Start of the date range (inclusive). Alternative to `dateRange`; provide together with `dateEnd`.; dateEnd (query) — End of the date range (inclusive). Alternative to `dateRange`; provide together with `dateStart`.; dataSource (query) — Filters results by data source.; eventType (query) — Filters results by event type. EVENT is a legacy alias for GENERAL.; outageType (query) — Filters results by outage type.; outageCause (query) — Filters results by outage cause.; tags (query) — Filters results by annotation tag. Matches annotations carrying at least one of the given tags.; query (query) — Filters results by a free-text match on the annotation description, id, or linked entities (location, ASN, origin).; asn (query) — Filters results by Autonomous System. Specify a single Autonomous System Number (ASN) as integer.; location (query) — Filters results by location. Specify an alpha-2 location code.; geoId (query) — Filters results by geolocation. Refer to [GeoNames](https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt).; origin (query) — Filters results by origin.; tld (query) — Filters results by top-level domain.; ca (query) — Filters results by certificate authority.; log (query) — Filters results by certificate log.; bot (query) — Filters results by bot.; format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.
